title: Conditional κ = 0.001717256973467002: post-cut partner correction on #2696's lender assignment with #2679's pre-life hosting
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001717256973467002308270944796906915212611876978096502828100…** (3046 decimals; the exact value is `kappa` in `research/gmx-t74-borrow43-handoff/outer/OUTER-CLAIM.json`, SHA-256 of the decimal string `93818aeaa04a53feeb6ff18e8cdf0d4be95a99dcbc89ddd8a078b3c789a00198`). This package stacks PR2696's (mason-hale) concentrated eight-lender source-partner assignment with PR2679's (philippeVV) six pre-life hostings (cold hosts 273/275/289/291/305/321 host helpers 482/483/494/495/507/519) and the one-gate frame refit with the retired-lender alias 653<-563, adds a post-cut partner correction (the four partner helpers' prelude warps and correction gates move after the centre cut, as explicit signed B-phase warp items; the lifted-target set shrinks to eight offsets and the four rank-7 plus rank-1 centre splits become rank-8 children) with a frame re-solve of the final word, and gives the result a priority-ordered call order and the window-optimal owner fill for it. The eight-lender words (`new/borrow/inputs/alias8_43*.json`) are PR2696's; they sit on PR2588's words (PR2530's (zxv) eight source-partner aliases with our swap of the helper labels of lenders 80 and 88); 415 helpers per call, local profile {1:2370, 2:646, 3:297, 4:120, 5:26, 7:4, 8:4}. PR2751 (tekuuu) was published earlier and reaches the same all-rank-8 centre profile by a different mechanism (its twelve-alias reassignment); the post-cut route is an independent alternative, not an improvement over it, and the only gain over PR2751 is the B1149 frame re-solve (+1.15e-7), found concurrently by PR2733 (mdumitrean). What changes: the words (the post-cut partner correction, stage `postcut` of `new/rebuild_borrow.py` with `new/borrow/inputs/postcut_43*.json`: verified by `new/borrow/audit_local.py` (extended to accept signed B-phase warp items) and the transport and tamper controls of `new/code/borrow/`, with controls rejecting a flipped inverse sign, a wrong operator, a wrong register, a misplaced timing and an omitted inverse or forward warp; PR2696's eight-lender assignment carried through PR2679's pre-life, refit and alias stages, which are re-checked on the combined state with their controls and both guards) and the owner side: the call order and dispatch (`new/borrow-fill/ORDER.json`, `DISPATCH.json`) and the owner fill for that order (`FILL.json.gz`; leftover idle {1:17316, 3:6594, 5:5216, 32:1, 48:26558}). The priority re-ordering idea is PR2621's (themilkman216); the evacuation method is PR2559's (philippeVV); the realize flows are PR2530's (zxv). New in this package, by Jeremy Kothe (jeremykothe2), with AI assistance: the post-cut partner correction with its verifier extension and controls, the stacking of PR2696's assignment with PR2679's hostings and alias, and the priority-ordered window-optimal fill, its exact checking (every window, bin, helper and family rule literal) and the integration into our pipeline. Conditional final kappa = 0.0017172569734670023082709447969069152126…(3046 digits) (supplier strict-assembly kappa 0.0017143130574144518034056624282464037255…(2995 digits)). It exceeds PR2751 (exact kappa from its claim, the live leader when this package was built) by 1.15387E-7 (exact gate in verify_release.py). grid_digits 2995, margin_digits 3005, bootstrap_steps 1116; 63 strict inequalities, 17 rejecting controls.

## Verification

Fresh checkout of `e8b771ba132fe632796b28c1742a8d096c04519f`. Manifest: `b78a248db5539549710565e1d1a3e3c39b3791fbf09d05c19043b593a53c9b44`.
PASS package manifest: 493 files

Supplier: the package's own unchanged `verify.py` (retained PR1297 provider and parent admission, owner reconstruction, parent lift, strict T74 admission, geometry controls): `PASS_T74_EXACT_FILL_COMPLETE_FINITE_ADMISSION`, native reuse none (fresh replays); its complex endpoint 171725697346700230827094479690... brackets the ledger's b = 1717256973467002308270944796906915212611…(3078 digits)/1000000000000000000000000000000000000000…(3081 digits). Outer (PR1673 capped phase-cell fusion): regenerated exact ledger (63 strict inequalities: the 62 retained rows plus the explicit main-binding row gaussian_above_main, the fixed-grid maximum kappa = C - 1/F - B asserted, 17 rejecting controls incl. the old g-factor union row, the old linear and old-theta chirp guards, the old 2*beta tag test, epsilon at 1 or at the r0 slack and beta outside its window, larger endpoint rejected by the native moment), independent balance derivation, the exact union-schedule simulation, the (retained, not used for kappa) structured-boundary displacement-rank check, the gauge-free identity/symbol/circuit checks, PR1786's finite prime/underflow controls and 19 exact evidence replays all pass. Conditional kappa 0.0017172569734670023082709447969069152126…(3046 digits) (union schedule outer/UNION-SCHEDULE.md; explicit Strassen boundary tau=45/16 (the structured boundary of outer/STRUCTURED-BOUNDARY.md is not used); gauge-free interiors outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md; fine source-prime padding PR1786 at the free point epsilon=1-(1025/1024)e-3080, outer/FINE-PADDING-COMPOSITION.md; fixed-grid maximum of PR2180/PR2161 (dataisfire), outer/PROOF-GRID-MAX.md; exact-integer coarse exponential PR2168/PR2184 (dataisfire) at the one 3000-digit rejection call).

Full package-owned verification passed in 682.92 seconds. The fresh receipt binds the exact package manifest and score.

See `research/gmx-t74-borrow43-handoff/README.md` for reproduction commands and proof qualifications.

## Follow-up fd7c7a72e

Theorem 4.1 in `outer/GAUGEFREE-INTERIORS.md` is restated with the absolute-scale guard `log(2+Λ+1/μ)` (thanks to Mister-Meeseeks' review on #1758; the unit-diagonal application and κ are unchanged). `new/PLAN.json` now pins regenerated natives including the 7 `postcut_*` controls, and `verify.py` LF-normalises regenerated text artifacts, so a fresh no-cache `verify_release` reproduces on Windows and Linux.
